scope: First full 660-frame rollout with exact Sharpa elastomer contact patches
summary: The v2 full rollout passes 296/300 exact force-closure frames and all 298 causal-response frames, but four contact frames fail and block acceptance.
evidence: Frames 401 and 405 retain only two exact fingertip pads and fail closure.
Frames 455 and 466 retain three pads and rank six but fail the strict positive-origin certificate.
Maximum exact accepted surface gap remains below 0.003 m and no threshold was relaxed.
The 660-frame run completes in 346.311 seconds; its physical stage report is not promoted because machine_acceptance_passed=false.
lessons: Position-only shoulder/elbow IK does not preserve grasp geometry over long motion because passive wrist orientation changes.
limitations: Four failed frames violate the all-frame contact contract.
The SSH controller disconnected, although the remote process completed and wrote a terminal report.
next_actions: Add contact-mode wrist orientation control and rerun in a new full directory.
